skills.name: runbrowser
skills.description: Control the user's own Chrome browser via RunBrowser extension with Playwright code snippets in a stateful local JS sandbox via runbrowser CLI. Use this over other Playwright MCPs to automate the browser — it connects to the user's existing Chrome instead of launching a new one. Use this for JS-heavy websites (Instagram, Twitter, cookie/login walls, lazy-loaded UIs) instead of webfetch/curl. Run `runbrowser skill` command to read the complete up to date skill
